questions.question: A 34-year-old woman presents with persistent fatigue, hyperpigmentation of the palmar creases and oral mucosa, orthostatic hypotension, and salt craving. Laboratory studies reveal hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, and fasting hypoglycemia. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial definitive test to confirm primary adrenal insufficiency (Addison's disease)?

A 58-year-old postmenopausal woman undergoes lumpectomy for a 1.5 cm invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast. Histopathology demonstrates clear surgical margins and negative sentinel lymph nodes (pT1c N0 M0). Immunohistochemistry reveals estrogen receptor-positive (ER+), progesterone receptor-positive (PR+), and HER2-negative tumor markers. Which of the following systemic adjuvant therapies is most appropriate for this patient?

A 29-year-old man presents with chronic diarrhea, abdominal bloating, an unintentional 5-kg weight loss over 4 months, and an intensely pruritic papulovesicular rash symmetrically distributed over his knees and elbows. Biopsy of a skin lesion reveals neutrophilic microabscesses and granular IgA deposits at the dermal papillae. Which of the following is the most sensitive initial serologic screening test for his underlying condition?

A 21-year-old man with type 1 diabetes mellitus is admitted to the intensive care unit with acute diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA). Resuscitation with isotonic saline and a continuous intravenous regular insulin infusion is ongoing. Which of the following set of parameters best indicates that the patient's DKA has resolved, allowing for a safe transition to subcutaneous insulin?
options: Blood glucose level < 300 mg/dL and complete absence of glucosuria
Resolution of nausea and normal serum potassium level
Venous pH < 7.25 and absence of urinary ketones
Serum bicarbonate ≥ 18 mEq/L, venous pH > 7.30, and closure of the anion gap

questions.question: A 42-year-old man with a history of active intravenous drug use presents with fever, chills, and shortness of breath. On physical examination, he is febrile (38.9°C / 102.0°F) and has a new grade 3/6 holosystolic murmur at the lower left sternal border that increases in intensity with inspiration. Blood cultures are drawn. Which of the following is the most appropriate empiric antimicrobial therapy while awaiting culture results?
